question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word: COVERT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"covert"** refers to something that is secret, hidden, or not openly acknowledged or displayed. (गुप्त, छिपा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The spy was on a covert mission to gather intelligence from the enemy territory.
 
 

 
• **"Open" **is the opposite of covert and means something that is visible, exposed, or accessible to everyone without any secrecy or concealment. (खुला, प्रकट)
 
 
• **Example: **The meeting was held in an open forum where everyone could participate and express their opinions.
 
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'covert' **is **'open'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hidden** (छिपा हुआ): Something that is kept out of sight or not easily accessible.
 
 
• **Example:** The treasure was hidden under the old oak tree.
 
 

 
• **Secretive** (गोपनीय): Tending to conceal one's feelings, intentions, or information.
 
 
• **Example:** He was very secretive about his plans for the weekend.
 
 

 
• **Guarded** (सावधान): Being cautious and reserved, often to avoid revealing too much information.
 
 
• **Example:** She gave a guarded reply when asked about her future plans.
